description: This file defines function prototypes, macros, and data structures related to establishing and managing network connections in a Git-related project. It includes functions for connecting, checking server features, and handling protocol versions.

methods.name: git_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection given file descriptors, URL, name, program, and flags.

methods.name: finish_connect
methods.description: Completes the connection process for a given child_process structure.

methods.name: git_connection_is_socket
methods.description: Checks if the connection is a socket.

methods.name: server_supports
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a given feature.

methods.name: parse_feature_request
methods.description: Parses feature requests from a string.

methods.name: server_feature_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a server feature.

methods.name: url_is_local_not_ssh
methods.description: Determines if a URL is local and not SSH.

methods.name: discover_version
methods.description: Discovers the protocol version with the server.

methods.name: server_supports_hash
methods.description: Checks if the server supports a specific hash feature.

methods.name: parse_feature_value
methods.description: Parses a feature value from a list.

methods.name: server_supports_v2
methods.description: Checks if server supports version 2 of the protocol.

methods.name: ensure_server_supports_v2
methods.description: Ensures server supports version 2 of the protocol.

methods.name: server_feature_v2
methods.description: Retrieves version 2 feature details from server.

methods.name: server_supports_feature
methods.description: Checks if server supports a specific feature, with error handling.

methods.name: check_stateless_delimiter
methods.description: Verifies the delimiter for stateless RPC calls.
